semantics: Native Cline host profile (Plan 032 Phase 8, ADR 0028): the artifact vocabularies a native Cline package may use, pinned to the CLI release line (the CLI section of the changelog baseline) and built on ADR 0013's verified discovery registry plus the real-session observations of 2026-10-02. The docs library describes only part of this surface; the rest is marked observed. Roles are configured agents (.cline/agents/<role>.yml) whose tools: list the host enforces.

configuredAgents.note: Roles ship as .cline/agents/<role>.yml (fenced frontmatter plus a body that is the system prompt); each becomes a tool subagent_<name> for the lead (ADR 0013, verified again on 3.0.68).

configuredAgentSkillsFilter.note: The skills: list scopes which skills a configured agent discovers; it does not preload their bodies (cline/cline PR 9502, per the legacy projector).

hostEnforcedToolRestriction.note: A configured agent with no tools: key can write, and with tools: [read_files] it cannot (observed on 3.0.68), so a read-only role needs no hook.

guardPlugin.note: A single-file plugin in .cline/plugins/ is auto-discovered and a throwing beforeTool hook blocks the call, for the main agent and for a subagent alike (observed); the throw ends the run of the agent that made the call, the whole run for the main agent and only that subagent's run for a subagent, so the lead continues and sees the error. Plugins apply to the CLI, SDK and Kanban, not the IDE extensions.

agentTeams.note: Teams work in the CLI, SDK and Kanban, not in the VS Code and JetBrains extensions; --team-name and --no-teams are absent from the 3.0.68 --help.

workflows.note: .cline/workflows/<slug>.md and .clinerules/workflows/ are slash commands (ADR 0013) and listed by cline config; headless invocation is untestable because a leading slash is rejected as an argument.

conditionalRules.note: A paths: conditional rule was in context with no matching file mentioned in the headless CLI, so treat every rule as always loaded there.

skillDirectories.note: Skills load from .cline/skills and .agents/skills (which wins a name clash) and ~/.agents/skills; the doctor warns on shadowing by an .agents copy.

claudeSkillsDir.note: .claude/skills is not loaded by the CLI although the docs say it is; do not rely on it (ADR 0013's registry does not list it either).

agentPlugins.note: The 3.0.62 notes describe packages under ~/.agents/plugins/* exposing skills as plugin:skill; a package of that shape was not discovered on 3.0.68.

mcpWiring.note: The file the CLI reads for MCP servers is unresolved (ADR 0013 found .cline/mcp.json absent from the 3.0.61 binary), so the package writes no MCP configuration yet.

ideExtensions.note: Everything in this profile was observed on the CLI; the VS Code and JetBrains extensions may use other tool names and locations.
